analysis.evidence: וּבְנֵי כוּשׁ means “and the sons of Cush.” The five names that follow identify Cush as their father.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew proper noun without a prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: סְבָא is the first name listed after וּבְנֵי כוּשׁ, “and the sons of Cush.” The later שְׁבָא, Sheba, is listed among the sons of Raamah.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew proper noun with no prefix or suffix.
